newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian import prices rise 0.1 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Australian import prices rise 0.1 pct in April.

text.p: Australian import prices rose 0.1 percent in April from the previous month to stand 4.1 percent below their level of a year before, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Monday.

"The value of the Australian dollar fell slightly against all major currencies except the Japanese yen, leading to a small rise in the (import price) index in April 1997," the bureau said in its monthly release.
Australian import prices have tended to fall since 1995.
The annual rate of import-price inflation troughed at minus 9.7 percent in June and July 1996 and has edged up since then.
